environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate with Aurora PostgreSQL. The database connection uses IAM authentication via a custom IAM policy attached to the ECS task role. The Aurora cluster has a custom DB cluster parameter group with 'rds.force_ssl=1'. The application's database credentials resolve to a PostgreSQL role 'app_ro_writer' which was provisioned through a Terraform module that applies a restricted GRANT set. The role has explicit privileges: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public; additionally GRANT UPDATE(username, email) ON users — meaning only the 'username' and 'email' columns are updatable. No INSERT, DELETE, or UPDATE on other columns (role, is_admin, balance, verified) is permitted at the database level. The pg_hba.conf equivalent in Aurora parameter group restricts this role to connections from the Fargate task CIDR only.

config.db_privileges: SELECT ON ALL TABLES; UPDATE(username, email) ON users ONLY
config.provisioning: Terraform module 'restricted-db-role' v2.3.1 with column-level grants
config.iam_auth: ECS task role with rds-db:connect permission scoped to app_ro_writer
config.network: Fargate tasks in private subnet, Aurora in isolated subnet, SG allows 5432 from Fargate SG only
config.runtime: ECS Fargate 1.4.0, ARM64, read-only root filesystem
